_about: Controlled vocabulary for broker-text extraction (EXTRACTION.md). extract_check.py rejects any dimension, field, unit, kind or clue type not listed here. Add to it deliberately, not per batch.

kinds.actual: a stated fact about this site
kinds.target: an aim or search criterion, not yet a fact ("~20 ac target", "2029 target")
kinds.range_low: lower end of a stated range
kinds.range_high: upper end of a stated range
kinds.text: wording kept as-is; no number to extract

power_connection.about: how the site connects: utility, substation, voltage, circuits, study stage

grid_constraints.about: upstream limits the broker states: transmission capacity, upgrades gating the date, interruptible service, study thresholds. Client input only; absence is 'not provided', never 'no constraint'

fiber.about: carrier quotes or fiber statements; broker-stated, never a proximity metric

flood_wetlands.about: any flood or wetland statement by the broker (rare)

acreage.about: site size; kind distinguishes actual vs target; parent tract separately

zoning_neighbours.about: zoning, permitted use, noise rules, neighbourhood words

site_control.about: deal fact, reported beside the evidence matrix, never inside it

schedule.about: the broker's own realism / schedule read

market.about: section / market the broker files the site under

other.about: anything worth keeping that fits no dimension; say what in the note

clue_types.intersection: two roads, with city and state: 'Main St & 2nd St, Town, ST'
clue_types.substation_name: an existing substation named as serving the site
clue_types.substation_planned: a new or planned substation named as serving the site (not in 2021 HIFLD)
clue_types.landmark: a named business, park or feature the site is next to, with city and state
clue_types.owner_name: owner or tract name that may identify the parcel
clue_types.area_name: a named district or area, e.g. a base or neighbourhood (context only, never geocoded)
clue_types.acreage: site acres (actual), used to size the stand-in square and to match parcels
